pubcol-w-d2f96c11986b1d46.definition_en: a group of residential buildings containing many separate flats, usually with shared facilities

pubcol-w-b7380bc044cba78b.example_complex: After the disturbance, a patrol of policemen was stationed at every entrance to reassure the frightened residents.

pubcol-w-6791531d5eaea390.example_complex: In the diagram, a pencil of rays leaving the object is refracted by the lens and brought to focus on the screen behind it.
